text: Riverside lift pump station: the drive motor on the main lift pump has picked up a faint grinding undertone in its hum. Please run the acoustic recording through bearing-wear analysis at the most precise setting you offer, and push it to the front of the queue since we need an answer before the evening demand peak.

hey, the residents' garage under our block keeps getting those whooping car alarms at 3am and nobody can tell whose vehicle it is. can we get something listening for that pulsing anti-theft horn pattern asap? the audio has to stay in the building though, and basic-grade detection is plenty.

During each filing season, the Provider shall extract from every Form W-2 received by the Client's tax-preparation office the wages paid, the federal income tax withheld and the employer's EIN, and shall populate the corresponding return worksheet fields. All scanned W-2 images and derived values shall be processed exclusively on hardware located within the Client's office premises and shall not be transmitted off site.

Council Chambers recorder: last night's planning meeting audio (2h 14m, English) is ready to be turned into a written, properly punctuated transcript of everything said. Keep the recording on the chamber's local server, ordinary accuracy is acceptable, and it can wait its turn with no rush.

Hey assistant, take the Gaussian splat capture we made of the Harbourview penthouse and render some fresh photoreal views from angles we never shot, like looking down from the mezzanine. No hurry on this one, whenever the queue gets to it.

Hi team, our walk-in clinic in Pasco sees a lot of Spanish-speaking patients, and at the intake desk we need something that interprets back and forth between them and our English-speaking nurses as each person takes their turn to talk. Everyday conversational accuracy is fine for this purpose. There's no deadline pressure, so slot it in on the usual schedule. Thanks, Marisol

Game-day overflow: need a running tally of open stalls across the four outdoor lots around the stadium so attendants can wave cars toward whatever room is left. Footage has to be processed on the venue's own servers, baseline accuracy will do, and please expedite because gates open in 90 minutes.

so we've got the service manuals for the new combine harvesters in English and the Quebec dealers need them in French, with the headings, torque tables and warning boxes laid out the same way. keep the files on our own server, decent everyday quality is fine, and no rush, whenever it fits in.

For the duration of the cross-border acquisition matter, the Service shall render each French-language share purchase agreement and ancillary contract into English, using the formal clause structure and legal terminology expected by common-law counsel. Renderings shall meet the most exacting fidelity tier available, preserving the precise legal effect of every obligation, warranty and indemnity. Documents designated for closing shall be handled on an expedited basis ahead of all other work.

Booth kiosk: 38 business cards scanned at the MedTech Expo stand today. Pull each person's name, email and phone number into the lead list, doing the processing on the kiosk itself so nothing leaves the booth.

Okay, when Spanish-speaking guests talk to the front desk, I want what they say turned into spoken English for the night clerk, voice to voice. Keep the audio on the hotel's own box in the back office, everyday quality's fine, and there's no rush to get it set up.

Hello, at the cooperative's packing shed we photograph every crate of mangoes and tomatoes on the sorting table, and we'd like those images scored for how evenly the skin has coloured and which ripeness grade each piece falls into, so we know what can ship to distant buyers. Ordinary grading accuracy is good enough. There's no time pressure, so it can go through the regular queue. Best, Tomas

The survey rover in the east decline drift is returning patchy LiDAR scans; we need those gaps filled and the noise cleaned out so we get full per-pixel depth frames registered to its RGB images. Processing must happen on the underground edge node, and ordinary accuracy is fine.

hey, i've got a bunch of photos of the donation tables from the church rummage sale. can you just tell me how many items are in each one? no labels or boxes needed, only the number, and it's fine to run it on whatever cloud machine you like.

The Provider shall convert Spanish spoken by witnesses and defendants during arraignment hearings into natural-sounding English audio delivered to the bench as speech. All courtroom audio shall be processed on equipment physically located within the county courthouse and shall not leave the premises. Translation shall be delivered at the most accurate tier offered, given the evidentiary weight of testimony.

Vineyard gateway alert: soil-moisture probes in the north block are sending bloated JSON readings that choke the LoRa backhaul. Re-encode each reading as a lean protobuf binary message using the schema already on the gateway; the default quality level is acceptable.
Hey, count how many things are sitting on the kitchen counter in this picture and just give me the number. Do it on the home hub without sending it anywhere, and there's no rush.

Hi Priya, the nacelle sensors at the Ridgeline wind farm are pushing verbose JSON telemetry that's eating our satellite uplink budget. We need those payloads re-encoded as lean Protocol Buffers binary before they go upstream. Please treat this as a priority job, since we're burning through the monthly data cap. Thanks, Dev

Ration pouch line: crumbs and sauce are getting caught in the heat-seal seams of the retort pouches, which risks seal failure in the field. Need the seam images checked for trapped product at the strictest accuracy you have, run on the plant's own inspection PC, and expedite it before the next pallet ships.

ugh, the forestry survey drive is full again with those giant multispectral GeoTIFFs from the drone flights and last month's Sentinel tiles. could you squash them down with tiled Deflate so they still open in QGIS? good-enough quality is fine and there's no hurry at all.

In support of mortgage underwriting, the Provider shall parse each applicant's PDF bank statements into structured rows capturing every transaction with its posting date, together with the closing balance for each statement period. Processing may take place on the Provider's off-premises infrastructure. Extraction shall be performed at the top accuracy grade the Provider offers, and requests shall be serviced in the ordinary course without expedited handling.

Data hall mantrap, north entrance: badge presented, face check pending. Compare the live face at the door against the enrolled authorised-staff list at maximum accuracy, and put it at the head of the queue since an engineer is waiting inside the interlock.

Hey, for the prescriptions dropped off at the pharmacy counter today, pull out each drug, its strength, how many units were ordered, and whether the prescriber actually signed it. Keep everything on the pharmacy's own computer and do it to the most exacting accuracy, but there's no rush, the routine queue is fine.

Hi Loss Prevention team, at our Maple Street supermarket we suspect a couple of cashiers are sliding items past the scanner for friends without ringing them up. Please run the checkout-lane footage through sweethearting analysis; it's fine to process it in the cloud, and regular detection accuracy is enough. We'd like this moved up the list as a priority since shrink spiked this week. Thanks, Janelle

Billing run closes tonight: field crew photos of the residential water meters on the Hillcrest route need the dial and LCD values pulled out as numbers. Ordinary accuracy is acceptable, but this needs rush handling so the bills go out on time.

honestly the upstairs meeting rooms at the coworking space get stuffy by mid-afternoon. could we hook up the CO2 ppm sensors so the HVAC dampers open wider when the readings climb? fine to crunch it in the cloud, and nothing fancy accuracy-wise, a basic tier is plenty.

The Contractor shall identify bags, suitcases and parcels left stationary and unaccompanied on the platforms and concourses of the Metro Line 2 underground stations, raising an alert to the transit security desk for each such item. Video from station surveillance may be processed at the Contractor's remote data centre.

BSL-3 suite airlock: near-infrared eye capture received from the entry scanner. Verify the iris pattern against the containment lab's cleared-personnel records before releasing the inner door; the comparison may run on the remote authentication cluster.

Hey, trucks keep clipping the old rail bridge on Mill Road, so watch the approach and warn me whenever a rig looks too tall to clear it before it reaches the underpass. Regular accuracy's fine, just make it a priority, I want this running tonight.

Hi Aaron, the two-lane roundabout at Kingsford and 5th has been backing up on the north leg during school pickup. Could you measure the gaps between circulating cars from the intersection footage so we can adjust the yield timing and lane markings? Processing it off-site is fine, typical accuracy will do, and this can go in the ordinary work queue. Cheers, Lena

Graduate admissions: 140 scanned transcripts from transfer applicants need every finished course, its credit hours and the letter grade pulled into the evaluation sheet before the committee meets tomorrow, so please rush it. Run it on the registrar's in-house server only, and accuracy has to be top-grade because these drive credit transfer decisions.

hey so the self-checkouts at the garden centre keep getting gamed, people scan a cheap seed-packet barcode and then put a sack of fertiliser on the scale. can we get something that flags when what the camera sees doesn't match what the bagging scale says? cloud processing is fine, it needs to be really accurate, and can we get it prioritised please

The Provider shall review recorded surveillance video from the emergency department entrances and waiting areas of St. Brigid's Hospital to identify any firearm, whether carried hidden on the person or openly brandished, for post-incident security audits. All footage shall be analysed on servers housed within the hospital and shall not be transferred to external facilities. Review requests under this clause shall be scheduled in the ordinary course and are not subject to expedited handling.

Parkway overpass sensor: a box truck approaching the Storrow Drive underpass appears taller than the posted 10 ft clearance. Keep checking each approaching commercial vehicle's height against the bridge clearance at the default accuracy level.

Hey, I just snapped a stack of business cards from today's investor lunch. Grab everyone's name, email and phone number off them and add them to my contacts right away, I'm following up before they fly out tonight.

Dear Imaging Informatics, our emergency department at Wagga Base runs point-of-care compression scans of the leg veins overnight, and we would like those cine clips screened for deep vein clots so a physician can act before the sonographer arrives in the morning. The studies must be analysed on the hospital's own imaging servers only. Please configure the screening at its most accurate setting and treat these as priority studies. Regards, Dr. Anand

Regulatory docs: the English operator manual for the IP-400 infusion pump needs a French edition for the Belgian and Swiss launch, keeping the section numbering, figures and warning layouts intact. Translation must be publication-grade and precise; this is a routine request with no deadline pressure.

quick one, the tote conveyor at the pharmacy distribution centre needs a count of the boxed products rolling past the scanner arch each hour. it's okay if the video gets processed off-site, and everyday accuracy is fine.

Clause 4.2: The Provider shall render the planetarium's multichannel object-based soundtrack binaurally, convolving each source with listener-specific HRTF sets so that visitors on headphones perceive every sound at its correct elevation and azimuth. All audio material and listener ear-measurement profiles shall remain within the planetarium's own facility throughout processing. Rendering shall meet the finest fidelity tier the Provider offers. This workload carries routine scheduling priority and is not to be treated as time-sensitive.

Virtual production stage tracking: the AprilTag boards on the LED volume ceiling were re-hung this morning. Please find them again and re-estimate their joint 3D poses as one constellation so the tracking solve stays consistent, processing on the studio's local render node. No rush, overnight is fine.

Hey, run through the dashcam footage from this morning's patrol on Route 9 and flag every pothole and deep wheel rut we drove over. Keep it on the truck's own computer, ordinary accuracy is fine, but treat it as a rush job so the patch crew can head out after lunch.

Hi Security Ops, the staff turnstiles at the Berth 12 gate need to check each worker's face from the gate camera against our authorised employee roster before letting them onto the terminal. Face data must be matched on the gatehouse server and never leave the port. Everyday matching accuracy is acceptable, but please fast-track the rollout since badge sharing was reported this week. Thanks, Omar

Flood relief shelter at the county fairgrounds: volunteers need what Spanish-speaking evacuees say turned into spoken English. Cloud processing is fine, everyday voice quality will do, and please expedite the setup as buses are arriving now.

so the gaming cafe's edge router falls apart every Friday night, pings jump from 20ms to 600 once the big downloads kick in. can someone check whether packets are piling up in the outbound buffers? fine to run the analysis remotely, a basic look is enough, and no rush, next week works.

The Provider shall scale down the full-resolution video feeds from the Pilbara haul-road cameras whenever the site's cellular backhaul degrades, lowering resolution so that the streams fit within the available uplink capacity. All transcoding shall be performed on equipment located at the mine site prior to any transmission.

Ultrasound cart, Ward 7B: bilateral leg compression cineloops uploaded for a post-op patient with calf swelling. Screen them for deep vein clot as a priority case, analysing on the hospital's local PACS node only.

Hey, someone's been messing with the cameras around the substation fence, one got spray-painted last month. Watch every feed for lenses being covered, knocked out of focus, painted over or turned away, use the most precise detection you've got, and treat this as top priority tonight.

Hi Marco, for the ski resort's base-area lots we'd like a count of empty spaces across all the open-air parking areas, fed to the signs on the access road. Processing can happen in your cloud, and the counts need to be very accurate since people decide whether to drive up the mountain based on them. There's no time pressure for this before opening season. Best, Ingrid
Traffic ops request for the three-lane roundabout at the Route 30 interchange: measure the time gaps between vehicles circulating past each entry so we can retune yield control and cut entry queuing.

hey, at the hostel front desk we scan guests' passports and ID cards at check-in, can we get the MRZ lines at the bottom read automatically? fine if it runs on a cloud server, and no rush, whenever you get to it.

The Provider shall monitor live surveillance video at the gates and concourses of Harbour Stadium on event days, identifying any firearm that is visibly brandished or carried beneath clothing. Each detection under this clause shall be treated as a priority event and escalated to venue security ahead of all other analytic workloads.

Orchard picker robot: the canopy LiDAR is returning sparse, speckled depth wherever leaves block the beams. Fill in and smooth those scans into full per-pixel depth that lines up with the gripper camera, on the robot's onboard computer only; ordinary accuracy works, but flag this as priority because picking has stalled.

Hey, the marathon course feed from the lead motorbike keeps freezing because the cell signal drops out in the hills. Knock the video down to a smaller resolution so it squeezes through the weak link, ordinary picture quality is fine, and do it right away, we're on air.

Hi Renata, following the quarterly shrink review for our three suburban stores, we'd like the recorded checkout-lane video examined for cashiers skipping the scanner or waving goods through for friends and family. Since findings may lead to disciplinary action, the analysis needs to be as accurate as you can make it. This isn't time-sensitive, so the regular schedule is fine. Kind regards, Paul

Campus network ops: unknown devices are flooding the dorm Wi-Fi with encrypted sessions. Fingerprint their TLS ClientHellos via JA3 hashes and label what kind of device each one is, keeping captures on the campus sensor box. Typical accuracy is enough; please expedite before the security review at 4pm.

so i've got a shoebox of business cards from ten years of chamber of commerce breakfasts. could you pull the names, emails and phone numbers into a spreadsheet? cloud is totally fine, and honestly whenever, there's zero rush.

The Provider shall generate new photoreal views of the museum's scanned sculpture galleries from the existing 3D Gaussian splat captures, at camera positions specified by the Client's curatorial team for the online exhibition. Rendered frames at the Provider's baseline fidelity shall be deemed acceptable under this Agreement.

Riverside Terrace quiet-zone node: please keep logging the rolling Leq in dBA across the residential blocks behind the bar strip, uploading readings to the council's cloud platform for processing. Ordinary measurement accuracy is acceptable.

Hey, pull up the borescope stills from the gas turbine outage at the power plant and check the ceramic thermal coating on the first-stage blades for chips or pitting. Ordinary accuracy is fine, and there's no rush, the unit stays offline till next week.

Hi Facilities, students keep circling the commuter lots on the west side of campus hunting for a space. Could we get a live count of the empty spots in each of the open-air lots pushed to the parking app? It's fine for the lot footage to be processed on your hosted servers. Thanks, Grace

WISP tower at Pine Ridge: subscribers report VoIP calls breaking up every evening once the backhaul fills. Check the edge router's egress queues for runaway buffering delay; analysis can run from our remote NOC, and please treat it as a priority since complaints are piling up.

hey, the elevator retrofit kit ships to Lyon next week and the installer manual is still English only. can we get it translated into French with the diagrams, callouts and step numbering kept as-is? the files can't leave our server, and yeah, this one's a rush.

The Provider shall analyse traffic camera video from the M4 motorway exit ramps to identify any vehicle travelling opposite to the lane's designated direction, compiling each occurrence into the monthly road-safety report. Requests under this clause shall be processed on a routine basis with no expedited handling required.

Construction noise sensor, Elm Street residential block: continue measuring the equivalent continuous A-weighted level at the nearest homes throughout works hours. Keep all audio and computed levels on the sensor node itself; everyday measurement precision is enough.

Hey, tower here, keep eyes on runway 27 and shout the moment any tug, fuel truck or maintenance van rolls onto it without clearance. Cloud processing is fine, it has to be as accurate as possible, and put this ahead of everything else.

Hi Kofi, the ripening rooms at our banana distribution site need the peel colour checked on this morning's pallets, meaning how evenly each hand has turned and what ripeness stage it's at before we dispatch to the stores. The photos can be processed on your cloud side. Please treat it as priority, the trucks leave at noon. Thanks, Hana

Housekeeping on the telecom cabinet gateways: take last month's uncompressed syslog output and journald files and squeeze them with zstd at level 19 to free up disk space. The regular quality tier is fine for this.

ok so at the used car lot the alarms on the trade-ins go off at night and the security guy never knows which one's wailing. can we set up something that picks out that honk-honk-honk alarm rhythm? audio stays on our own box in the office, and a basic level of accuracy is totally fine.

The Provider shall cross-reference every door-contact alarm raised at the museum's collection storage vault with the corresponding security video, confirming whether the door was physically forced rather than opened with valid credentials. Correlation under this clause shall be performed at the Provider's premium accuracy tier.

Outbound conveyor, cosmetics fulfilment centre: count every boxed retail unit passing the packing station so today's order totals reconcile. Video may be processed off-site, and flag this as priority because the courier cutoff is 5pm.

Hey, hook my webcam up to my VTuber model so all 52 blendshapes follow my face, brows, cheeks, jaw, the lot. It's fine to run the tracking on a cloud server, and regular quality is good enough for my streams.

Hi team, since the autumn term started, students in our lecture theatres keep dropping off the campus Wi-Fi, and I suspect the APs are stepping on each other's channels. Could you survey how much same-channel and overlapping-channel RF noise each ceiling-mounted 802.11ax access point is picking up? It's fine to ship the captures off to your remote analysis cluster. No rush on this one, just add it to the usual queue. Thanks, Priya

Womenswear floor, flagship department store: we need each changing cubicle's occupied or free status tracked, plus how long every customer spends trying things on, processed on the in-store server only. Accuracy must be top-tier, and please rush this before the Black Friday weekend.

hey, the changing rooms at the outlet store are chaos on weekends, nobody knows which cubicles are taken or how long folks are in there. can we get proper tracking of that? super accurate please since we're using it for staffing, and asap if possible.

The Provider shall tone-map HDR video captured by the Client's broadcast cameras at regional football fixtures into SDR output suitable for the older displays and set-top boxes used in partner venues. Processing may be carried out at the Provider's remote facilities. Conversion at the Provider's baseline quality tier is acceptable, and all jobs under this clause shall receive priority scheduling.

Stamping plant, press bay floor: coolant and hydraulic fluid keep pooling around the presses. Please watch the floor video for puddles and slick spills, processing it on the plant's local server; ordinary accuracy is fine and this can run in the routine queue.

Hey car, I'm hard of hearing, so listen out for any ambulance, police or fire siren coming up behind me and flash it on the dash. It's fine to process the audio in the cloud, I need it as reliable as you can make it, and there's no rush setting it up.

Hi Stefan, the reefer container monitors aboard the MV Kestrel are sending temperature and door-state readings as chunky JSON, and the ship's VSAT link can't keep up. Each payload needs re-encoding into protobuf binary, and that conversion has to run on the vessel's own gateway. The default encoding quality is fine, but please make this a priority since we're losing readings as we speak. Regards, Ana

Border checkpoint freight lanes: undercarriage images from the last hour of trucks need screening for explosives, hidden packages or anything strapped to the chassis. Images can be processed at the regional analysis centre, and please expedite, traffic is backing up.
hey can you count the things in this photo of our office supply cupboard and give me just a number? keep it on the office computer, it doesn't have to be super exact, and no rush.

The Provider shall estimate, from the showroom's camera frames, the prevailing direction of incoming light and its colour temperature in kelvin, so that virtual furniture placed through the Client's augmented-reality app is shaded consistently with the room. All frames shall be processed on equipment within the Client's home-furnishing showroom. Estimates at the Provider's ordinary accuracy tier are acceptable, and requests under this clause shall be handled on a routine schedule without expedition.
Molding cell, dashboard vent housings: parts coming off the press need checking for short shots where the cavity didn't fill completely, and for sink marks on the thick ribs.
Hey, measure how cloudy the filtered water is in NTU at each filter outlet of the Lakeview treatment plant, and keep that data on the plant's own system. No rush, this is just routine monitoring.

Hello, across our twelve regional rail stations we've had platform cameras bagged over, spray-painted, knocked out of focus and twisted to face the wall. We'd like every feed checked for that kind of interference, and it's fine to process the video in your cloud. Accuracy should be the best you offer, since false alarms send staff out needlessly. This isn't pressing, so the usual scheduling is fine. Regards, Siobhan

Council environmental health: residents in the Northcote quiet zone dispute the club's noise figures. Log continuous Leq in dBA at the three kerbside monitors, analysing on the council's cloud service at the most precise measurement grade available; routine handling, no deadline.

hey, for the summit this weekend every car rolling into the hotel's underground garage goes over the undercarriage camera. can we get those shots checked for bombs or anything taped under the chassis? cloud's fine, it needs to be dead accurate, and please make it top priority.

For collision reconstruction reports, the Provider shall compute how fast each involved vehicle was travelling from its displacement between successive frames of the Client's calibrated intersection footage. Speed estimates shall be delivered at the Provider's most rigorous accuracy grade, suitable for submission as expert evidence. Requests under this clause shall be scheduled in the ordinary course without expedited turnaround.

Operatory sensor: new bitewing set captured for today's recall patient. Screen the films for decay between the teeth and dark periapical areas at the root tips, analysing on the practice's own server only; routine-level accuracy is fine.

Hey Nova, listen to the parking garage mics on level three and tell me whether that on-off honking cycle is somebody's car alarm, and bump it to the front of the line. Keep the audio on the garage's own box, don't send it anywhere, and ordinary accuracy is plenty.

Hi Dr. Whitfield, our overhaul shop has borescope and bench images from the HP turbine stage of two regional-jet engines, and we need the ceramic thermal barrier layer on each blade assessed for spalled or pitted areas. The images may be uploaded to and analysed on your hosted platform. Given the airworthiness implications, the assessment must be at the finest accuracy you can provide. Best regards, Karl

Multi-storey car park: several dome cameras were covered with tape or bumped out of alignment over the weekend. Monitor all feeds for blocking, blurring, spray paint or repositioning; processing may run on the vendor's cloud, and everyday detection accuracy is sufficient.

hey, the iris reader at the vaccine lab entrance went down after the update and people are stuck outside. can you get the NIR iris scans checked against the lab's approved access list again asap? regular matching accuracy is fine for now.

The Provider shall extract, from each scanned academic transcript submitted to the Nursing Registration Board, every course the applicant finished together with its credit value and the grade awarded. Transcripts and extracted records shall be processed only on systems within the Board's offices. Extraction at the Provider's baseline accuracy tier shall satisfy this clause.

ICU bed 14 POCUS probe: anterior chest clips uploaded after central line insertion. Check both lung fields for missing pleural sliding that would suggest a collapsed lung; clips may be analysed on the cloud triage service.

Hey, look through these photos from the storage unit and draw boxes around every object you can find, whatever it is. Nothing fancy, ordinary accuracy is fine, but I need it back quickly, so please prioritise it.

Hi Jordan, we're replacing the badge readers at the staff entrance of the Northgate distribution office with face checks. Each person's image from the door camera should be compared against our list of employees cleared to enter the building before the lock releases. Let me know what you need from HR to set this up. Thanks, Mei

Island ferry terminal: the berth CCTV uplink runs over a 4G modem that sags in bad weather, so please step the streams down to a smaller resolution whenever the link degrades. Transcode on the terminal's local box, everyday picture quality is enough, and this can go in as a routine job.
so marketing wants to know if the new snack endcap actually holds people's attention. can we work out how long, in seconds, shoppers stand there looking at it before they wander off?

The Provider shall review bitewing radiographs submitted by the Client's mobile school dental program, flagging caries on the contact surfaces between adjacent teeth and radiolucent lesions at the root apex. Images may be transmitted to and analysed at the Provider's off-site facilities. Findings at the Provider's ordinary accuracy tier are acceptable, and reviews shall proceed on a routine schedule without expedited turnaround.

Scholarship portal: 62 scanned transcripts uploaded by this year's applicants. Pull each completed course name, the credits it carried and the grade letter into the scoring sheet with maximum accuracy; routine processing is fine, the panel doesn't meet until next month.

Assistant, the vessel's berthing early, so I need a fast tally of how many container columns are standing in bays 14 through 22 of the terminal yard, top priority. Make it the most precise count you can manage, because the stowage planner can't work with guesses.

Hello, We're adding face-based entry to the mantrap doors of our colocation data centre. When someone steps up to a door, the lens there should compare their face with the enrolled staff and contractor badge roster and only release the lock on a match. Because these are biometric records, every image and template has to stay inside this building. Regards, Facilities Security

Requesting a catch-all object finder for the lost-and-found intake photos at the municipal library: box and label whatever items appear in each shot, nothing domain-specific. Baseline accuracy is acceptable, and this can sit in the regular queue with no time pressure.

hey, the nail salon next door keeps getting headaches from the acetone and gel fumes, can we hook up something that reads the TVOC level in ppb in their back room? fine if the readings get crunched on a cloud server, basic accuracy works, and honestly no hurry, next week is ok

Section 3: The Contractor shall convert the courtroom's 48 kHz multi-microphone recordings into single-channel 16 kHz audio before they are passed to the transcription engine, thereby shrinking the payload the speech recogniser must ingest. Such conversion may be executed at an off-premises facility. Jobs under this section shall be expedited ahead of all other workloads.

SoundSense alert: the hallway mic in Building C picked up a sudden burst of noise. Please label what kind of sound it was, whether a slammed door, a revving motor, shattering glass or something else, and handle it as a priority job. Cloud-side analysis is permitted; everyday accuracy is sufficient.

Hey Dent, go through the bitewings I just took for the patient in the second chair and point out any decay between the teeth plus dark shadows at the root tips. Use maximum diagnostic precision, and rush it, she's still sitting there waiting.

Hi Marco, Our tenants' association has started photographing each flat's electricity, water and gas meters at month end instead of relying on the utility's estimates. Could you set up something that pulls the running total off each dial or odometer-style register in those photos so we can reconcile the bills? Cheers, Hana

ICU request: clinicians want the point-of-care probe clips reviewed for loss of the pleural gliding sign that would suggest air collecting around the lung. OK to process on the vendor's hosted servers. Needs the most accurate model available, since a miss here is unacceptable.

yo can you throw a general object finder at the photos from our garage cleanout, boxes around everything it recognises, nothing specialised. cloud processing is totally fine and decent accuracy is enough, but I need it bumped ahead of the queue since the estate sale listing goes up tonight

4.1 The Supplier shall identify standing water and slick fluid leaks across the production floor of the bottling plant so that slip hazards are flagged to floor supervisors. Identification shall be delivered at the most accurate grade the Supplier provides. Requests under this clause shall be expedited and processed ahead of routine work.

Kiosk voice module: incoming 48 kHz microphone capture from the airport info desk should be reduced to 16 kHz single-channel before it reaches the speech recogniser. Remote conversion is permitted. Apply the finest resampling filter available so no speech detail is lost.
Hey Radi, pull the chest films that just came up from the ER and flag any showing lobar consolidation or airspace opacities, and put those first in line.

Hi Leon, Before Friday's dispatch audit we need exact tallies of the boxed goods travelling along the sortation belt at our Parramatta fulfilment hub. Please count each packaged unit as it rides past the overhead camera and send totals per hour. Processing in your hosted environment is fine, but the figures must be as precise as possible and this needs to jump the queue. Best, Mei

Ward voice-command pilot: the bedside mics capture at 48 kHz but the speech model only accepts 16 kHz mono, so each feed needs resampling and channel folding first. Patient audio may not leave the hospital's premises.

ok so people at the self-checkouts keep scanning a cheap barcode and bagging something pricier, like the camera clearly sees a steak but the scan and the bagging-area scale say carrots. can we get something that flags when the item's look doesn't fit the scan and the weight? no hurry on this, it can wait its turn

The Vendor shall examine molded polypropylene housings leaving Press Line 3 for short shots, where the cavity failed to fill completely, and for sink depressions over thick wall sections. This inspection work shall be scheduled at ordinary priority and is not considered time-critical.

Survey upload complete: 38 GB of multispectral orthomosaic GeoTIFFs from today's vineyard drone flight are ready to be shrunk using Deflate compression with internal tiling. Keep the files on the research station's server throughout. Regular priority; nothing about this is pressing.

Hey Medi, I've got one patient here who only speaks Pashto and another in Tigrinya, so translate my triage questions like where does it hurt and are you allergic to anything back and forth for me, and treat this as top priority. Cloud processing is fine.

Dear Instrumentation Team, Following last night's storm runoff, the filtration plant needs continuous NTU turbidity readings on the post-filter line feeding the town's drinking water supply. Please configure the measurement at the most precise resolution your nephelometers support. This is a priority request and should be actioned ahead of scheduled work. Kind regards, Operations
Council complaint follow-up: log continuous A-weighted Leq sound levels along Elm Street inside the designated quiet residential precinct beside the new nightclub.

hey, can we get the yard cams at the empty-box depot to tally how many container piles are standing in each row? the footage has to stay on the depot's own server, and no rush, sometime this week is fine

The Provider shall listen for the configured activation phrase (e.g. "Hey Concierge") in the always-on microphone audio from guest suites and signal each occurrence to the room controller. Audio may be analysed on the Provider's off-site infrastructure. Baseline recognition accuracy shall be deemed sufficient for this service.

RoadWorks Alert: lane closure on the M4 westbound at the Prospect roadworks. Watch whether drivers take turns merging at the taper and stay in their lanes along the cone line, flagged as priority. Video must stay on the roadside unit; apply maximum-precision analysis.
